FUNCTION assign_vehicle_group_id()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_vehicle_group_id()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  existing_group TEXT;
BEGIN
  -- Look for an existing vehicle with the same make, model, body_type, and generation
  SELECT group_id INTO existing_group
  FROM public.vehicle_catalog
  WHERE make       = NEW.make
    AND model      = NEW.model
    AND body_type  = NEW.body_type
    AND generation = NEW.generation
    AND group_id   IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1;

  IF existing_group IS NOT NULL THEN
    NEW.group_id := existing_group;
  ELSE
    NEW.group_id := generate_group_id();
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

FUNCTION create_organization(p_name text, p_phone text, p_email text, p_website text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_organization(p_name text, p_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_website text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_org_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Create the organization
  INSERT INTO public.organizations (name, phone, email, website)
  VALUES (p_name, p_phone, p_email, p_website)
  RETURNING id INTO new_org_id;

  -- Make current user the owner
  INSERT INTO public.org_members (org_id, user_id, role, joined_at)
  VALUES (new_org_id, auth.uid(), 'owner', NOW());

  RETURN new_org_id;
END;
$function$

FUNCTION generate_invoice_number(p_org_id uuid)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_invoice_number(p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_next INT;
BEGIN
  -- Advisory lock scoped to the transaction; auto-released on commit/rollback.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(abs(hashtext(p_org_id::TEXT)));

  SELECT COALESCE(
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN invoice_number ~ '^INV-[0-9]+$'
        THEN substring(invoice_number FROM 5)::INT
        ELSE 0
      END
    ), 0
  ) + 1
  INTO v_next
  FROM public.invoices
  WHERE org_id = p_org_id;

  RETURN 'INV-' || lpad(v_next::TEXT, 5, '0');
END;
$function$

FUNCTION process_invitation(p_user_id uuid, p_user_email text)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_invitation(p_user_id uuid, p_user_email text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_invitation invitations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  -- Find a pending, non-expired invitation for this email
  SELECT * INTO v_invitation
  FROM invitations
  WHERE email       = p_user_email
    AND accepted_at IS NULL
    AND expires_at  > NOW()
  LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN FALSE;
  END IF;

  -- Add the user to the org
  INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role)
  VALUES (v_invitation.org_id, p_user_id, v_invitation.role)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  -- Mark invitation as accepted
  UPDATE invitations
  SET accepted_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = v_invitation.id;

  RETURN TRUE;
END;
$function$
